tools.name: csv-to-table
tools.description: Fetch a public https CSV URL and parse it into headers + rows ($0.005 USDC via x402). https only — http, file, data, localhost, and private IPs are rejected. Caps: 1 MB body, ~10s timeout, max 5 redirects, max 5000 data rows (truncated with warning). Optional has_header (default true). Returns JSON
